name: The LOST Saga
detailed_description:
The Labyrinth Of Sublime Terror Saga, or The LOST Saga, is the first of three ambitious RPG Backrooms Titles. In this game, you can exit reality and enter into The Deep, and soon after find yourself lost within The Backrooms.

Features:

  • A main story and 17 alternative endings.

  • NOT a walking simulator, the main storyline provides you with tasks you must accomplish on your journey throughout The Deep.

    • Some pathways are "walking simulators" should you want to deny your destiny and experience that classic backrooms game feel.

  • Unique Levels that have never been adapted into a Backrooms Game.

    • Closely follows the wiki for how such levels are designed.

  • Custom Levels not seen on the wiki.

  • Voice acting for all character dialogue.

  • Created mostly by one person, with help from a few friends.

What Sets The LOST Saga Apart From Other Games

  • An Expansive Backrooms Universe with several meticulously hand-crafted Backrooms Levels.

  • Meet an array of characters that would be willing to help you, and some that wouldn't.

  • Join Guilds/Factions like The Major Explorer Group (The MEG), to advance your progress through The Deep.

  • Expanding Content: Updates will come as a "Chapter" system. Currently, there are six (6) chapters planned for the mainline story within the scope of this game. 

  • Every choice matters.

short_description: The LOST Saga is an ambitious RPG game that plunges you into The Deep and is a game based on the analog horror concept of "The Backrooms". Explore many liminal spaces as Levels in this horror game, make friends, join guilds, and do so much more.
